A '''planet''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was orbited by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] entity [[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]] who lived inside an abandoned [[Space station/Legends|space station]], connected to it by an organic tether. The planet was in tidal lock with [[Unidentified planet 2 (Mother)|another planet]] of the [[UR-6572-AK system/Legends|system]].
